findings.rationale: The aws_security_group.jump ingress rule opens TCP 22 to 0.0.0.0/0, placing an administrative shell directly on the internet.

aws_iam_role.escalation trusts an unrestricted principal and aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.escalation grants it broad privileges, allowing the role to be assumed without a narrowly scoped trust boundary.
connectivity.json links the internet-reachable sg-jump node to role-escalate through sts:AssumeRole, giving a remote shell a direct identity-escalation path.
The wildcard IAM statement in tf_iam_open is compounded by the public-read ACL on the tf_s3_public_access bucket, combining an overprivileged identity with publicly reachable data.

findings.rationale: aws_iam_policy.wildcard sets Statement[0].Action and Statement[0].Resource to *, creating a maximally broad identity grant.
